claims.statement: The declared dependency surface is enumerated: 493 components from 86 Maven POMs and 3 npm lockfiles; 402 of 437 external components have a resolved version.
limitations: Static declaration parse only: transitive Maven dependencies are not expanded, so this is a direct-dependency inventory rather than a full build graph.
Versions supplied by an imported BOM are recorded as managed-by-bom, not resolved; running Maven is required to pin them.
Properties are flattened across the reactor; a property redefined with different values in different modules is dropped rather than guessed.
No vulnerability lookup is performed, so this inventory alone does not establish CVE exposure.

claims.statement: A credential scan over 7800 files across 33 declared roots produced 11 actionable findings and 2615 advisory high-entropy hits. The actionable findings are untriaged: none has been confirmed as a live credential or dismissed as a fixture.
limitations: secretLeakCount counts actionable findings only; high-entropy strings are advisory and require triage without gating.
Merged from chunked runs; only the roots listed under coverage were scanned and anything outside them was not examined.
Scans the working tree only; git history is not examined.
Detection is rule and entropy based; a zero result bounds risk, it does not eliminate it.
No secret is validated against its provider, so a finding may be an already-revoked credential.
Triage is outstanding. Every actionable finding must be either fixed or added to config/secret-scan-allowlist.json with a reason, an owner and an expiry before this claim can pass.
